serve.description: Catalog discovery (change mcp-agui-a2ui-registry 1.1, decision D15). GET on this route returns the embedded mcp/ui/catalog/ipfs-mcp.catalog.json byte for byte as application/json; the catalog is embedded from that generated file and no copy of it exists anywhere else in the tree. The route lives under the AG-UI mount, so it exists only when /agui is mounted (--agui on, otherwise 404) and passes the same protection chain as /agui: Host check, Origin policy with the strict CORS answer scoped to agent.origin_allowlist, request body limit, bearer authentication, and the /agui default principal kind ui (an a2a or admin token gets 403). The catalogId above stays the A2UI identifier used in createSurface.catalogId; this route is only how an AG-UI client fetches the document. D15 scopes this phase to catalog discovery plus server-built surfaces, so the route serves the one published catalog and nothing model-composed.

aguiEvents.description: CUSTOM event names in the AG-UI run stream (D15, resolving assessment-backend Q6: the advertisement is a CUSTOM event, not a RUN_STARTED field, so RUN_STARTED keeps the AG-UI lifecycle shape and agent.a2ui: false silences every A2UI event without touching the run lifecycle). surface carries one A2UI v0.9 message per event (createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel) built from a tool result by the chatRules; it must stay equal to aguiA2UIEventName in mcp/server/agui_a2ui.go. catalog is the catalog advertisement: exactly one CUSTOM event per run, emitted immediately after RUN_STARTED and only when agent.a2ui is on, with value {"catalogId": <catalogId>, "catalogUrl": <serve.route>}. A client that ignores both loses nothing: the island keeps its local ToolCallCard fallback.

description: A2UI component binding references. Catalog tools name a view component in ui.a2uiComponent; mcp/ui implements each component against the bound tools' output schemas and publishes the A2UI v0.9 catalog manifest. catalogId is the canonical A2UI catalog ID: a URI used only as an identifier, never fetched; it equals the manifest $id, and servers list it in supportedCatalogIds and use it in createSurface.catalogId. catalogAliases are short names for docs, logs and configuration; they are never sent as an A2UI catalogId. Chat components wrap every tool call in the agent chat; which chat elements apply to a tool is derived by the chatRules, never authored per tool.

components.name: PinList
components.description: Pins with type, name and verification state; paginated.

components.name: MfsTree
components.description: MFS directory tree and file details.

components.name: DagViewer
components.description: IPLD node, DAG statistics and CAR import/export results.

components.name: IpnsRecordCard
components.description: IPNS name, resolved value and keystore keys (never key material).

components.name: ConfirmationDialog
components.description: Renders a confirmation Summary for elicitation-capable surfaces.

components.name: NodeStatusPanel
components.description: Node identity, server status, peers, provider and peer lookups, provide announcements, bandwidth, repo and index status.

components.name: ToolCallCard
components.description: One tool call with arguments and result; embeds the tool's view component when it has one.

components.name: ApprovalCard
components.description: Interrupt state for a write or destructive call: pending, approved, denied, expired, waiting for the system prompt. Shows no approve control when the approval is out of band.

components.name: EgressBadge
components.description: Marks results that carry node content and states which acknowledged host may receive it.
